name: Rocketry
boundaries: Rocketry: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.original_title: Practical, fully reusable single-stage-to-orbit vehicle with airline-like turnaround
original_dispositions.reason: The air-breathing path is ROC-01. A chemical single stage is described as integration of existing engines and structures; recovery, refueling, and cadence are execution of known rocket physics.

original_dispositions.original_title: High-thrust nuclear thermal propulsion above 900 seconds, with rapid restart, for a crewed Mars transfer in under three months
original_dispositions.reason: Solid-core reactors were ground-tested at about 860–875 seconds. A flight would deploy a known engine class; the open-cycle gas core is ROC-04. A sub-three-month crewed trip is not a direct consequence of a roughly 900-second solid-core stage by itself.

original_dispositions.original_title: Stable, manufacturable metallic hydrogen as a storable propellant above 1000 seconds
original_dispositions.reason: The cited study did not observe zero-pressure metastability, while noting the quest is not finished. The notes classify a positive result as a condensed-matter discovery with rocketry as a consequence; the theoretical impulse was not re-verified.

original_dispositions.original_title: Fully integrated air-breathing and rocket combined-cycle engine for horizontal takeoff to orbit
original_dispositions.reason: The overlap is flagged in ROC-01. The retained threshold is air-breathing through most of orbital specific energy.

original_dispositions.original_title: Ultra-durable thermal protection for 100 or more reentries with zero refurbishment
original_dispositions.reason: The notes characterize it as durability engineering on a survival problem already flown, without changing the energy source or rocket equation.

original_dispositions.original_title: Megawatt-class electric propulsion above 5000 seconds with thrust enough for crewed or heavy cargo missions
original_dispositions.reason: High-impulse electric thrusters have flown; the power source needed for substantial thrust is a separate advance.

original_dispositions.original_title: Zero-boil-off cryogenic storage for five to ten years
original_dispositions.reason: The notes characterize the remaining work as flight qualification of known cryocooler and insulation practice, important for depots but an engineering margin on fluid storage.

original_dispositions.original_title: Practical ground-based beamed-energy propulsion to orbit
original_dispositions.reason: The same concept is covered by ROC-02. DARPA POWER delivered electricity to a receiver and was not a launch.

original_dispositions.original_title: Industrial-scale propellant production on the Moon and Mars, at hundreds of tons per year
original_dispositions.reason: ROC-08 retains a proposed first 10-ton load produced, transferred, and used in flight; hundreds of tons per year is a later scale of the same plant.

original_dispositions.original_title: Hybrid or gelled propellants that combine liquid performance with solid-like storability and safety
original_dispositions.reason: No inspected primary measurement was found outside the chemical specific-impulse band. The notes explicitly identify an evidence gap in the gel literature and a scope judgment about ordinary chemical impulse.

reconciliation_change_log.change: 1 November 2026 reconciliation: all eight first-pass concepts and their IDs are retained; none was deleted, replaced, or merged into another ID, and no ROC-09 or later ID was assigned.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Nothing in the historical list or further check met the stated revolutionary-impact bar as a new rocketry principle.

reconciliation_change_log.change: NASA’s X-43A record statement was checked; SABRE’s approximate Mach 5 air-breathing design point and administration record were sourced. Wikipedia’s more precise inlet-closure figures remain secondary. Historical item 4 overlap is flagged.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Preserve the flight record, distinguish the design from a flown orbital air-breather, and retain the threshold of air-breathing through most of orbital specific energy.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Added DARPA POWER’s 2025 electricity-delivery result; retained the Myrabo Lightcraft flight and flagged historical item 8 as the same concept.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The receiver test did not propel a vehicle.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Sourced Starshot’s on-hold status to Pete Worden’s email as quoted by Sarah Scoles; retained the tethered laboratory membrane result.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Organizational status and a laboratory measurement are not a laser-sail spacecraft flight.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Corrected the briefing author to Harold P. Gerrish Jr.; retained the official NTRS title typo, reactor count and fuel figures; checked DRACO cancellation and return-on-investment remark.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Distinguish the proposed open-cycle gas core from the already ground-tested solid-core class.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Added the 2025 alpha-particle surrogate experiment in a 3-tesla magnet; retained the 2023 statement that no dusty-plasma reactor had been tested.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The experiment is component science, reports no thrust, and leaves critical aerogel assembly as a research question.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Added the laboratory negative E-sail force measurement and the 2026 statement that a plasma magnet has yet to be demonstrated in space. Kept E-sail as a sibling within ROC-06 and withdrew the first-pass 350–800 km/s band.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Avoid counting the same solar-wind capability twice and avoid retaining a specific speed band not tied to an opened source.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Added ADRASTEA’s suborbital tether-release attempts from its abstract; retained HASTOL’s 2001 conclusion.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The flight did not catch an independent payload in orbit or raise its orbital energy.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Separated the proposed first 10-ton production, loading, and flight demonstration from a later rate of hundreds of tons per year; flagged historical item 9 as the same concept.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: MOXIE remains a gram-scale oxygen demonstration; no off-Earth flight tank has been loaded.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Historical items 4, 8, and 9 are covered by existing concepts. Items 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, and 10 were not added. The historical source URLs are recorded as missing, misidentified, or not supporting the claimed list.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The reconciliation found no additional item meeting the same revolutionary-impact bar.
